Thank you all for bringing these issues forward. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and what needs to happen before I can approve this engagement.

First, Marcus — this conflicts issue is significant. Second, Nadia — thank you for the thorough patent review. If the only credible invalidity basis is for claim 7, then our litigation plan should reflect that scope. We shouldn't overstate our invalidity defense for the other asserted claims. Please circulate your research note to the intake group so we're all working from the same understanding.

Third, Tom — a $300,000 total fee cap through trial is a firm condition from the client. That's a critical term that needs to be reflected in the engagement letter before I sign off. Please get that entered in the client-relations record.

Given the conflicts issue alone, I cannot approve this engagement today. We need informed written consent from both clients and the ethical screen in place first. So my decision is conditional: we will accept the representation only if (1) we obtain informed written consent from both the medical-device company and the opposing party, (2) we implement an ethical screen separating our litigation team from the opposing party's files, (3) the engagement letter reflects a $300,000 total fee cap through trial, and (4) our invalidity defense is limited to claim 7 only.

Marcus, Nadia, Tom — please each get your respective items documented and finalized so I can review everything before next Wednesday's deadline. Let's reconvene once the conflicts safeguard is in place.
